# Mauro Delgado — Executive Coach PCC & Senior Consultant

> Mauro Delgado is an ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC) and senior consultant based in Barcelona, Spain, with 20+ years of international corporate leadership (Amway, Weight Watchers, Mail Boxes Etc., Picking Pack) and 6,000+ hours of executive coaching. He works with CEOs, senior executives and high-potential leaders of multinational companies, online worldwide and in person in Barcelona, in English, Spanish and Catalan. Certified practitioner of The Leadership Circle Profile® and DISC & Motivators.

His approach is evidence-based and draws on frameworks such as Carol Dweck (growth mindset), Daniel Goleman (emotional intelligence), Robert Dilts (logical levels), Robert Cialdini (ethical influence), Patrick Lencioni (team dysfunctions), Adam Grant, Stephen Covey, Ray Dalio, Harvard Business Review, John Kotter (8-step change model), Verne Harnish (Scaling Up) and McKinsey & Company. Coaching processes follow his CIMA Method: Clarity → Impact → Mobilization → Sustainable Action.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://mauro-delgado.com/servicios.html): executive coaching (1:1), Scaling Up business consulting and team workshop facilitation. Focus areas: strategic thinking, influence and persuasion, high-performing teams, leading change, prioritization and focus, personal branding.
- [Assessment center preparation & executive promotion](https://mauro-delgado.com/assessment-center-preparation.html): individual coaching for executives of multinational companies facing an assessment center or promotion process to senior leadership roles. Development-focused and authentic, not test coaching: executive presence, emotional management and decision-making under pressure, role plays, competency-based interviews, business cases and self-awareness through personality assessments. Two formats: development process (~6 months) or intensive preparation (minimum 8 weeks).
- [Leadership Circle Profile® diagnostic](https://mauro-delgado.com/leadership-circle-profile.html): 360º leadership assessment with certified debrief.
- [The Executive Impact Snapshot](https://mauro-delgado.com/termometro.html): free online self-assessment of your leadership pattern under pressure.
